text: still not correct. lets start by doing this, when i click on a face, make the face an entirely different shade than every other face so we can track it easier
resolution: Added a vivid solid shade over the SELECTED face(s) so the active face is unmistakable while we debug loop cut. facesGeometry(mesh, faceIndices, push) in editMesh.ts builds a thin overlay geometry of just the selected faces, fan-triangulated and pushed out along each face normal by STUDIO.selectFacePushMeters (0.004m) to avoid z-fighting. Studio.tsx renders it as an extra Scene3D.Mesh in STUDIO.selectFaceColor (#ff8a3d, distinct from the pastel part tints), keyed on a stable face signature so it only re-uploads when the selection or part geometry changes. Shown in face mode whenever faces are selected; suppressed during loop-cut preview (the face index no longer maps onto the cut mesh). Bundle-clean; hot-reload TSX; nothing committed.
